question: With one pass per loop, does one restart from the best board (router.autorouter.restarts_from_best=1: the fanout, then the passes again from pass 1, kept only if it beats the best board) leave fewer unrouted connections than the same run without it on at least N-1 of the registered boards, with none worse, no via in a pad, no copper below the board minimum, no more real DRC items than the run without it, and at most twice its maze work on every row?
setting_name: Q23's checklist names the setting router.autorouter.restarts; that key is Q12's removed portfolio setting (crates/freerouting/src/settings/removed.rs refuses it with its removal note), so Q23.3 implements it as router.autorouter.restarts_from_best, and the restart arm sets that key

base.engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main after Q23.3 lands, one Linux build for both arms (its --version git sha in Q23.4's note); the default profile enhanced
base.what: baseline: the fanout, then pass 1, then the loop's finish (best-board restore)

restart.engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main after Q23.3 lands, one Linux build for both arms (its --version git sha in Q23.4's note); the default profile enhanced
restart.what: base, then one restart from its best board: the fanout and pass 1 again, kept only if its router score beats the best board's

boards.eligibility: every row of the set, fixed here before any run: the PCU rev 2.0 board as Q23.1 continued it (v7's 60-minute output final_v7 with the committed .kicad_pro and .kicad_dru beside it; skipped when the file is missing, and then the verdict has one board fewer), the three canary-pwr pour variants of owner.txt, and the three benchmark.txt boards with 500 or more connections whose default run takes at most about 10 minutes (Issue690-kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213 541, Issue753-CPU-85_r104 569, Issue066-Project_GP8B 759); a row on which base leaves no unrouted connection is neutral and reported, not dropped
boards.grouped: fixtures/canary-pwr/canary-pwr-pours{1,2,3}.dsn are one board for pass_rule (variants of one placement; their unrouted counts are summed), so the verdict judges 5 distinct boards (4 without the PCU file)
boards.row_flags: each row's own router flags, in its set comment and in rows below: the PCU board takes Q23.1's (the Pour1A and Pour3A classes as plane obstacles, the stub cleanup), canary-pwr its own saved options' (start_ripup_costs 1500, min_trace_width_um 150, as Q10 and Q20), the benchmark boards none

rules_files.note: the PCU row's final_v7.kicad_pro and final_v7.kicad_dru beside the board: the committed board's (1b161c7), as Q23.1 ran it

grading: one grade per distinct output (an arm whose output is byte-identical to the other's shares its grade). kicad (the PCU row): kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones --format json on the input board and on the router's .kicad_pcb output, with the committed .kicad_pro/.kicad_dru beside both and the copper classes forced to error, routing-caused items counted as tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh counts them (Q22.2: an item that involves a track or via the input does not have at the same coordinates, width, layer and net), via_in_pad by tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py; canary (canary-pwr rows): Q10's canary grade (fixtures/canary-pwr/README.md, Grading); router (the benchmark rows, which have no KiCad project): the router's own checks, see metric_definitions. kicad-cli only while `pgrep -a kicad-cli` shows none; every route under ulimit -v 8000000, one at a time

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: vias whose copper overlaps an SMD pad that the input does not have: kicad rows via_in_pad.py on the output board; canary and router rows freerouting-dev gate collect's session_via_in_pad on the DSN with the SES
metric_definitions.below_minimum: routed copper below the board minimum: kicad and canary rows the grade's copper.below_minimum; router rows the result manifest's output_check.by_rule track_width + via_diameter + annular_width + drill_out_of_range of the routed copper the run saved (Q20's check, profile enhanced's output_check=repair; its `remaining` must be 0)
metric_definitions.drc_real: real DRC items the routing caused: kicad and canary rows the grade's drc_real; router rows the clearance violations of `freerouting-rs -drc` on the DSN with the SES, minus those of the DSN alone
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's unrouted count of the saved board: the result manifest's board_statistics.connections.incomplete_count
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: KiCad's unconnected items of the graded board (kicad and canary rows only); reported
metric_definitions.maze_work_units: the run's `--stats json` total.counts.maze_work_units (every maze search of the job, the restart's included)
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: the run's elapsed wall time (other routes may not overlap: one at a time); reported, not compared

work_guard.rule: on every row, restart's maze_work_units is at most 2.0 times base's (a restart is at most one more first loop); a row over it fails the work guard

keep_rule: the paired rule on unrouted (the canary-pwr rows summed as one board): restart improves on at least N-1 distinct boards and is worse on none; every hard metric 0 in restart on every row; drc_real not higher than base's on any row; the work guard holds on every row. Print the luck rate 1 in 2^N for the N distinct boards judged
validity: a row is left out (named with its reason, `--left-out ROW=REASON`) only when an arm hit its safety --timeout (the job log's timeout line or the result manifest's timed-out state; the timeout keeps the best board, so the row would compare time, not work) or its input file is missing (the PCU row); with fewer than 3 distinct boards left the verdict is NOT MEASURED

decision_table.pass: keep the restart stage opt-in (router.autorouter.restarts_from_best unset in both profiles, not in ENHANCED); its DIVERGENCES line stays; Q23.5 may follow N05's recipe under the totals rule with its own registration
decision_table.fail: any of the paired rule, a hard metric, the drc_real guard or the work guard fails: remove quality/restart.rs, its setting, its batch-loop hook, its help text and DIVERGENCES line (Q rule 5); Q23.5 closes with a note
decision_table.not_measured: fewer than 3 distinct boards judged: no decision; the stage stays opt-in and Q23.4 stays open

stop_rule: one run per arm and row (the engine is deterministic, D2); no reruns with other pass caps, restart counts, timeouts or row lists
not_registered: pass caps other than --max-passes 1 (the default passes take hours on the PCU board; decided 2026-10-22: short runs only)
an equal-work arm (base with --max-passes 2): Q23.1's `long` question, not this verdict
the PCU board's unrouted placement (placed_v7 or unrouted-1b161c7): its fanout and pass 1 alone take 5 to 10 minutes per arm
timing: registered before any Q23.4 number; Q23.3's tests and determinism checks on q06-sole-wall, q06-fixed-cage and the small benchmark boards are not runs of these arms
